faq_heading: Homes near Belmont Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Belmont Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Langley School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Belmont Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: By name: a listing shows up when its description mentions Belmont Elementary. Ask Jared to watch for nearby homes that leave the school out.

faq.q: How much do homes near Belmont Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 56 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,302,500. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Belmont Elementary?
faq.a: Near Belmont Elementary (1 km), homes took a median 28 days to sell and closed at 96.5% of the list price, with 7% over asking, across 56 sales.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Belmont Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Noel Booth Elementary (1.0 km south), Alice Brown Elementary (1.2 km north-west) and Brookswood Secondary (1.2 km east).

The search below lists homes for sale whose listing names Belmont Elementary. Under it are the prices homes sold for within 1 km of the school.
How the Belmont Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Belmont Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Belmont Elementary

12 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Belmont Elementary in a straight line (8 elementary, 2 other, 1 secondary, 1 middle; 2 independent). The closest is Noel Booth Elementary, 1.0 km away, and the farthest on this list is Murrayville Academy, 3.0 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Brookswood Secondary (1.2 km); the nearest independent school is St Catherines School (1.6 km). Other elementary schools close by: Noel Booth Elementary (1.0 km south), Alice Brown Elementary (1.2 km north-west), Uplands Elementary (1.3 km north-east), St Catherines School (1.6 km south), Simonds Elementary (1.7 km north). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Noel Booth Elementary, 1.0 km south of Belmont Elementary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Belmont Elementary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Langley school finder. A home a few blocks from Belmont Elementary can sit in a different catchment.
Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near Belmont Elementary are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.

Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median house within 1 km of Belmont Elementary was $1,302,500, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
Look at Noel Booth Elementary, the nearest other elementary school, 1.0 km south of Belmont Elementary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
